places.name: The Getty Center
places.description: Richard Meier's travertine hilltop museum in the Santa Monica Mountains. Van Gogh's Irises, Rembrandt, Impressionists. Free admission, gardens with Pacific and city views.
highlights: 360° panorama of LA and Pacific from gardens

places.name: Grand Central Market
places.description: Downtown LA's historic market hall since 1917. Egg Slut eggs, Eggslut queues, Ramen Hood, Wexler's pastrami, Sticky Rice Thai. The democratized food hall of DTLA.

places.name: Griffith Observatory
places.description: Art Deco observatory on Mount Hollywood, 474m above LA. Free, public telescope use at night. Planetarium shows, Nicola Tesla's Tesla coil. Hollywood Sign hike start.

places.name: The Broad
places.description: Contemporary art museum opened 2015. Jeff Koons, Kara Walker, Jean-Michel Basquiat, Cindy Sherman. Infinite Mirror Rooms by Yayoi Kusama — book months in advance.
highlights: Kusama Infinity Mirror Rooms — book early
Jeff Koons balloon dogs permanent display

places.name: Venice Beach Boardwalk
places.description: Legendary 3.2km oceanfront promenade: Muscle Beach outdoor gym, street performers, skaters in the Bowl, drum circles at sunset. Los Angeles beach culture at its most uninhibited.
highlights: Sunday drum circle at the end of Windward

places.name: LACMA
places.description: Largest art museum in the western United States. 142,000 objects from antiquity to present. Chris Burden's Urban Light — 202 antique street lamps — is LA's most photographed artwork.
highlights: Urban Light — 202 lamps, best at dusk

places.name: TCL Chinese Theatre
places.description: Hollywood's most iconic cinema since 1927. Forecourt of Stars: 200 celebrity handprints and footprints in concrete. First cinema to host a Star Wars premiere.

places.name: Nobu Malibu
places.description: Nobu Matsuhisa's flagship restaurant on Malibu's Carbon Beach. Black cod with miso is the signature — a dish that changed American Japanese cuisine. Celebrities on every terrace table.
highlights: Black cod with miso — Nobu's signature dish
